title: Tarantulas, scorpions and more found in luggage at Peru airport
html:
Tarantulas, scorpions and more found in luggage at Peru airport

Peruvian authorities have intercepted two Chinese nationals at Lima’s international airport as they attempted to smuggle 677 wildlife specimens to China in their luggage. The haul, including hundreds of tarantulas, centipedes and scorpions, was valued at $100,000.
summary: Tarantulas, scorpions and more found in luggage at Peru airport
